title: Business Development Associate
description:
**Company Description :**  
Varsity by InterviewBit is an education platform focused on preparing students and professionals for careers in an AI-first world. Its programs are built with faculty from premier institutes such as IIT Delhi and IIM Trichy, ensuring curricula that track where the industry is actually moving rather than relying on recycled content. Learners gain portfolio-ready proof of work, ongoing coaching and mentorship, and access to a strong professional network that continues beyond course completion. Varsity offers a wide range of future-focused disciplines, including GenAI, data science, applied quantum, AI-powered operations, and forward-deployed engineering. Backed by InterviewBit’s proven track record of placing engineers in top global tech companies, Varsity combines rigorous academics with outcome-driven, accessible tech education.

**Role Description:**

* Reach out to prospective learners across multiple communication channels.
* Understand learner aspirations, challenges, and long-term career goals.
* Build trust through clear, helpful, and confident conversations.
* Explain programs, mentorship model, and learner outcomes.
* Qualify prospects and recommend the right learning pathway.
* Follow up consistently with existing and potential learners.
* Manage daily inputs, outputs, and performance targets effectively.
* Represent the mission with energy, ownership, and conviction.

**Qualifications:**

* Graduation is mandatory from a recognized university or institution. Candidates from any academic background are welcome.
* Excellent verbal and written English communication skills, with the ability to confidently communicate with prospective learners and understand their requirements.
* Strong passion for sales and business development, with a willingness to work in a target-driven and high-performance environment.
* Customer-centric approach with strong listening, relationship-building, persuasion, and objection-handling abilities.
* Experience handling ₹50K+ ticket sizes is preferred, particularly in EdTech, Education, B2C, Inside Sales, or other consultative sales environments.
* Ability to understand customer needs, identify pain points, and effectively position a product or solution accordingly.

Pay: ₹100,000.00 - ₹600,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Business Development Manager
description:
We are looking for a candidate who has got at least 2 years of full-time sales & marketing experience in IT sector in a reputed organization with similar position.

- You need to research and identify new **business** opportunities - including new markets, growth areas, trends, customers, partnerships, products and services - or new ways of reaching existing markets.

- You need to increase revenues, **growth** in terms of **business** expansion, increasing profitability by building strategic partnerships and making strategic **business** decisions.

- You need to focus on three growth strategies: Market penetration, Market development, Product development.

- You need to generate a strong pipeline of leads through your own network.

- Proficiency in at least two languages and any Completed Degree ( Fresher )

- Communication, Time management, creative and planning skills

- Ability to manage multi-task

- Developing goals for the development team and business growth and ensuring they are met

- Understanding the basic financial concept

- Ability to make presentations

- Ability to deliver the presentation to the key person and a large group of gathering

- Good selling skills

- Utilizing existing networks and relationships to build new business

- Ability to work in a team or standalone plus a determination and motivation to exceed targets

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Commuter assistance
* Internet reimbursement

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Trichy, Tamil Nadu: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Experience:

* Business development: 1 year (Preferred)

Language:

* English (Preferred)

Work Location: In person
